quotes.text: I've tried it, but I haven't seen anything that overly impressed me in terms of accuracy. I'm sure there are applications for LLMs where the quality of the answers is less important, but I don't have any of those.
quotes.author: jacquesm
quotes.source: Hacker News — Run Qwen 3.8 Flash Next (125B) on consumer hardware (RTX 4090) at 100T/s
quotes.extraction_note: Grug-brained skepticism of the LLM speed race — cutting through tokens/sec flexing to ask the only question that matters (does it work?). The closing 'but I don't have any of those' lands hard.
